custom.notes: FS wilds are RARE (own 120-stop fsReelStrips, all 5 reels). 3sc=per-spin expansion (0-5 wilds/spin, cleared each spin); 4sc=STICKY (towers accumulate, cap 5). FULL BOARD = 5 wild reels = INSTANT MAX WIN (5000x) in BOTH bonuses (fullBoardInstantMaxWin). 1-4 wilds pay natural ways. Reel 0 carries a wild (needed for the 5-tower full board). 3sc-fullboard ~1-in-75M (legendary); 4sc-fullboard ~0.5%. High volatility, base game strips unchanged.

viceBuyStages.fsStripsRule: buy3 BOUGHT round: its own 1215-stop FS strips, 42 wilds per reel. Re-fitted together with the tower multipliers. Ship the stop arrays VERBATIM — at this wild density the arrangement is a first-order lever (same multiset, different shuffle measured 96.19 / 92.47 / 90.56 / 92.61).
viceBuyStages.note: Forced 3-scatter trigger, then a per-spin-expansion free-spins round on the strips above. 1-4 wilds pay natural ways; 5 full wild reels = INSTANT MAX WIN (custom.fullBoardInstantMaxWin). No simultaneous-expansion multipliers and no full-house multiplier exist any more. Hot spins never fire on a bought round (expansion would erase the scatters the player paid for).
viceBuyStages.label: 100X BET

viceBuyStages.fsStripsRule: buy4 BOUGHT round, stage 2: its own 2406-stop FS strips, 24/16/16/16/15 wilds and 18 scatters per reel, re-fitted together with the first-spin reel-0 tower guarantee and the tower multipliers. Ship the stop arrays VERBATIM — at this wild density the ARRANGEMENT is a first-order lever (the same 22/16/16/16/15 multiset measured 95.88% in one shuffle and 99.21% in another), so they cannot be regenerated from the wild counts.
viceBuyStages.note: Forced 4-scatter trigger, then a STICKY round to towerCap 5. GUARANTEED TOWER: if the FIRST free spin would land none, reel 0 slides forward onto a wild (fires in 83.6% of rounds) — the round is sold as a tower round, so it always shows one. Reel 0 because the engine folds a column-0 wild to HIGH_A, making that tower ~10x cheaper than any other. Tower multipliers 1x-5x apply as everywhere; hot spins never fire on a bought round.
viceBuyStages.label: 200X BET

anteBet.label: 3x FREE SPINS CHANCE
anteBet.rule: Ante strips: base symbol mix scaled x8 (320 stops) carrying the extra scatters that buy the ~3x trigger chance, plus RAISED wild density (17/17/16/16/16 = 5.3% of stops vs 2.5% natural). The free spins still roll the SHARED top-level fsReelStrips, so at a locked 1-in-18 trigger the ante FS income is fixed at ~1.8x bet; the remaining value for a 3.25x price has to come from the ante BASE spins, and wild density is the only lever left once scatters are pinned by the trigger promise and the paytable is fixed.
anteBet.hotSpinDependency: The ante fit leans on hot spins roughly twice as hard as natural play: with hotSpinChance1In active it measures 96.00% (20M rounds, ±1.16pp), with hot spins disabled it drops to ~84%. If hot spins are ever dropped, the ante MUST be re-fitted. buy3/buy4 are unaffected (hot never fires on a bought round).
anteBet.certifiedBy: custom-math/sim_vice_core.mjs (live round core), seed 771177, 2026-07-28 — WITH tower multipliers. The previous 95.52%/40M figure came from a separate tool and predates the tower-multiplier mechanic, so it could not describe the shipped game: the ante draws ~64% of its RTP from the free spins, which is exactly what that mechanic changed.
anteBet.measurementNote: Per-round std is ~20x of stake. A 4M-round run carries a ±2.54pp interval — ours read 94.3% and was noise. Do not re-fit the ante off anything under ~20M rounds.

custom.towerMultiplierRule: Every reel standing FULLY WILD in a FREE SPIN is dealt a badge 1x-5x from towerMultiplierWeights. A winning ways combination pays x the HIGHEST badge among the expanded reels it CROSSES (a combo starts on reel 0 and runs matchCount reels, so it crosses reels 0..matchCount-1). Scatter pay is NEVER multiplied, and nothing is applied on top of the 5-wild INSTANT MAX WIN. HIGHEST, not the product: the product is multiplicative in tower count and measures 187% RTP on a bought 4-scatter round.
custom.towerMultiplierStickyRule: A 4-scatter STICKY tower keeps the badge it was dealt when it JOINED, for the rest of the round. A 3-scatter round re-expands from scratch every spin and therefore draws fresh badges each spin.

simResults.tool: custom-math/sim_vice_core.mjs — drives the LIVE round core (src/game/viceSpin.ts), i.e. exactly what the game pays
simResults.ruleSet: ENGINE ways evaluator (= SlotGame.sol:341, a column-0 wild folds to HIGH_A) · TOWER MULTIPLIERS 1x-5x, HIGHEST crossed badge · no simulExpandMultipliers · hot spins on (no badge)

simResults.invariants: credited-sum === totalWin, totalWin <= cap, no negative credits, re-derivation deterministic — ZERO violations in every run

params.fsStrips: fsReelStrips (rare wilds, 120-stop, 1 wild/reel = 3x rarer than base) — the FS rolls these, NOT the base strips; a full-wild board is a genuine jackpot
params.instantMaxWin: 5 full wild reels pay exactly maxWinMultiplier x bet instantly (custom.fullBoardInstantMaxWin) and end the round — the 5000x MAX WIN marquee, in BOTH bonuses
params.note: 3sc = per-spin expansion (5-simul instant max ~1-in-333k/bonus); 4sc = sticky towers accumulate to cap 5 (max win only ever at 4-5 standing towers, ~0.74%). DISPLAY MUST ROLL fsReelStrips so the shown towers are exactly what settles.

params.weights: towerMultiplierWeights [55,20,9,6,10] = x1..x5; every reel standing FULLY WILD in a free spin is dealt one
params.apply: HIGHEST crossed badge — NOT the product (product measures 187% RTP on a bought 4-scatter round) and NOT the sum (floors at 90.53%)
params.never: scatter pay is never multiplied; nothing stacks on the 5-wild instant max win; hot spins carry no badge
params.sticky: a 4sc sticky tower keeps the badge it was dealt when it JOINED for the whole round; a 3sc round re-expands each spin and draws fresh badges
params.randomness: CRITICAL: draw the badge from a RESERVED seed namespace (ours: keccak(seed, 1<<200)) so the reel-stop stream is untouched — reels must land identically with the mechanic on or off, or every certified RTP here is void for your build
params.presentation: art badge x1..x5 (theme/vice/wild_multi_sheet.webp, 5 frames) seated in the lower third of the column (slotYFrac 0.86, sizeFrac 0.82) so it clears the WILD lettering; it POPS on when it locks — see visualParams expandWildMultiPop / expandWildMultiPopTime

params.note: no fly-to-center collect; win anim + zoom only

GENERATOR FEATURE (Noski): expose a per-event VOLUME parameter for EVERY audio event in the real generator UI. audio.events[<id>].volume in this preset is the operative loudness of the shipped build (design default merged with the volume sliders) — reproduce it 1:1 and make each one adjustable. The sound LIBRARY picker is studio-only and NOT part of this feature.
params.source: audio.events (complete: every registry event with file + volume + loop/exclusive flags)

params.presentation: forced stops carry the bought scatter count — 2 land, tease arms, rest drop like a natural trigger; board evaluated in full (display == payout)
params.guaranteedTower: 4-scatter buy only: guaranteedTowerOnFirstSpin — if the first free spin would land with NO fully-wild reel, guaranteedTowerReel is advanced to the next stop whose window holds a wild. Without it 15.5% of bought rounds (1 in 6.4) showed no tower at all on a buy sold as "10 sticky tower spins"; now 0%, fires on 83.6% of rounds, mean 2.03 towers at round end. Bought rounds ONLY — never a natural or ante trigger. Priced in: the buy stays 200x.
params.stripSwapWarning: when a stage swaps in its own strips, swap reelLengths WITH them — we shipped a round where they desynced and the display rolled a different board than the settlement scored, so wins highlighted the wrong cells

params.label: 3x FREE SPINS CHANCE
params.note: toggle: every spin costs bet x anteBet.costMult and runs on anteBet.reelStrips (certified ~3x natural trigger chance)

win.placement: FS-trigger beat, grows 1.28 over resting look

frameWinFlash.placement: overlays the frame texture at region; one-shot on 3rd scatter land

stages.note: PLATFORM BRANDING — identical in every generated game. Currently MISSING from the dev build; it has to run before anything else renders.

params.mount: inside the game-canvas container only (the game iframe) — never over the host/studio chrome; position absolute, inset 0, zIndex 30

logo.playback: ONE-SHOT then HOLD — a logo build-in, never a loop or a spinner
logo.stepping: transform (NOT background-position), steps(8, jump-none) on both axes: row on the wrapper, column on the inner strip
logo.whyTransform: background-position re-rasterises the sheet every step and stutters while the real assets decode
logo.whyJumpNone: plain steps(n) lands between cells and renders half-frames — it looks garbled and too fast

bar.cap: max-width keyframe 0% -> 100% over 4.2667s linear, fill both
bar.rule: shown = min(width, cap) — THE BAR MUST NOT REACH FULL BEFORE THE LOGO HAS FINISHED PLAYING
bar.whyCss: a per-frame JS clock competes with the asset decoding this screen exists to cover

params.nonCriticalJobs: everything else is fired unawaited and streams in behind the overlay — it must never hold the bar back

exit.startsAt: max(criticalJobsSettled, 4267ms + 280ms hold) measured from boot start
exit.armsNext: showGameIntro() runs before the fade, so the iris-from-black is already in progress
exit.whyFloor: on a warm cache the assets settle in a few hundred ms; without the floor the logo is torn away mid-build and reads as a broken flicker

renderer.spritesheetPlayback: one texture per sheet file, frames cut as sub-rectangles (no per-frame images); advance frames on a ticker at the sheet fps — never re-upload textures per frame

mixingRules.marqueeStart: duck('ambient-music', 300ms fade to 0, keeps looping muted) + play('win-marquee')
mixingRules.marqueeEnd: fadeStop('win-marquee', smooth ? 900 : 260 ms) + unduck('ambient-music', smooth ? 700 : 400 ms)
mixingRules.duckDefaults: SoundManager duck default 350ms, unduck default 450ms (overridden by the explicit values above)
mixingRules.reelSpinLoopFade: fadeStop 450ms the moment reel 0 stops; safety fadeStop 90ms when all reels stopped
mixingRules.scatterDingLadder: rate = 1 + min(n,3)*0.14 per scatter in one landing sequence; counter resets after 4000ms silence
mixingRules.winStepChimeLadder: rate = 1 + min(index,8)*0.09 per connection (vice keeps the chime ladder; no per-symbol quips)
mixingRules.winStingerGate: state-driven win-small/normal/big/mega thresholds 2x/10x/50x bet; ALL suppressed when ratio >= minBigWin 15 (marquee owns audio); coin-chime accents at 200/600ms (big) +1100/1700/2300ms (mega) — moot at design volume 0
mixingRules.ambientAutoplay: play on mount + pointerdown/keydown unlock + first-spin fallback; exclusive flag makes double play a no-op
mixingRules.teaseArc: onTeaseStart: duck('ambient-music',350) + play('tease-riser'); onTeaseEnd(hit): fadeStop('tease-riser', hit?120:60) + unduck(500) + play(hit ? 'free-spin-trigger' : 'tease-miss')
